site.title: Homepage settings
site.subtitle: Manage the appearance of the homepage.
site.heroDescription: Image displayed as the background of the homepage hero section. The bottom of the image fades into the dark page color. If you don't set your own, the built-in default photo is shown. Landscape format recommended. Large images are optimized automatically. JPEG/PNG/WebP.
site.heroDesktopDescription: Image displayed as the background of the top section on computers and tablets. The bottom of the image fades into the dark page color. If you don't set your own, the built-in default photo is shown. Landscape format recommended. Large images are optimized automatically. JPEG/PNG/WebP.
site.heroMobileDescription: A separate vertical image displayed as the hero background on phones — it fills the whole screen behind the content card. If you don't set your own, the built-in default vertical photo is shown. Portrait format recommended. Large images are optimized automatically. JPEG/PNG/WebP.
site.noHeroImage: No custom image — the built-in default photo is used
site.noHeroMobileImage: No custom mobile image — the built-in default vertical photo is used
site.focalPointHint: Drag the image to set the focal point visible in the homepage hero section.
site.deleteConfirmMessage: The image will be removed and the homepage will return to the default gradient. This cannot be undone.
site.deleteMobileConfirmMessage: The mobile image will be removed and phones will return to the built-in default vertical photo. This cannot be undone.
site.badgeDescription: Optional badge displayed in the top-right corner of the hero section on the homepage (e.g. PZA logo).
site.deleteBadgeConfirmMessage: The badge will be removed from the homepage.
site.badgeLeftDescription: Optional badge displayed in the top-left corner of the hero section on the homepage.
site.deleteBadgeLeftConfirmMessage: The badge will be removed from the homepage.
site.badgeLinkHint: Clicking the badge on the homepage will open this URL in a new tab.
